heading_en: Treatment of Tranched Credit Risk Mitigation Techniques
summary_ja: 階層化された信用リスク削減手法について、提供側のみなしトランシェの扱い、受け側が留保する部分の扱い、K_IRB及びK_SAの算出、外部格付準拠方式を用いる場合のリスク・ウェイトの区分を定める。
summary_en: Sets how tranched credit risk mitigation is treated for providers and recipients, including deemed tranches, the use of K_IRB or K_SA, the risk weight to apply where the original exposure would use the external ratings-based method, and non-senior treatment.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company provides the credit risk mitigation effect of a tranched credit risk mitigation technique (meaning a credit risk mitigation technique under which the credit risk of an exposure is divided into multiple tranches of differing priority and the credit risk of one or more tranches is transferred to one or more persons providing the credit risk mitigation technique; the same applies in the following two paragraphs) for a securitization exposure, it shall apply the provisions of this Chapter and calculate the credit risk-weighted assets by deeming itself to directly hold, among the multiple tranches into which that securitization exposure has been divided, the tranche for which it provides the credit risk mitigation effect. In this case, each divided tranche shall be deemed to be one tranche created in the original securitization transaction (meaning the securitization transaction that gave rise to the creation of that securitization exposure; the same applies hereinafter in this Article).

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company receives the credit risk mitigation effect of a tranched credit risk mitigation technique for a securitization exposure it holds, it may take the credit risk mitigation effect into account only for the portion of that securitization exposure for which the effect is provided.

In the case of the preceding paragraph, where, as a result of taking into account the credit risk mitigation effect of the tranched credit risk mitigation technique, there is a portion that retains the credit risk of the securitization exposure held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, it shall apply the provisions of this Chapter and calculate the credit risk-weighted assets of that portion by deeming that portion to be one or more tranches created in the original securitization transaction.

In calculating the credit risk-weighted assets of a securitization exposure relating to the tranche for which an Ultimate Designated Parent Company provides the credit risk mitigation effect prescribed in paragraph (1) and the portion that retains the credit risk prescribed in the preceding paragraph (hereinafter in this Article referred to as "deemed tranches"), where it applies a risk weight calculated using the internal ratings-based approach-compliant method or the standardized approach-compliant method, it shall calculate K_{IRB} prescribed in Article 232 or K_{SA} prescribed in Article 243 for all of the underlying assets in the original securitization transaction, and shall calculate the attachment point (A) and detachment point (D) for each deemed tranche.

Where, on the assumption that an Ultimate Designated Parent Company bears the credit risk of the original securitization exposure before its division into multiple tranches (hereinafter in this paragraph and the following paragraph referred to as the "original securitization exposure") itself, it is determined pursuant to Article 228 that the external ratings-based approach-compliant method is to be used in calculating the credit risk-weighted assets of that original securitization exposure, the following risk weights shall, according to the classification of the status of the deemed tranche held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company set out in the following items, be applied in calculating the credit risk-weighted assets of the securitization exposure relating to the deemed tranche: (i) where it is the tranche with the highest priority among the multiple tranches into which the original securitization exposure has been divided: the risk weight of the original securitization exposure calculated using the external ratings-based approach-compliant method; (ii) where it does not fall under the preceding item and a rating can be inferred from a tranche created in the original securitization transaction that is subordinate to that original securitization exposure: the risk weight calculated pursuant to Division 3 or Division 7 of the preceding Subsection on the premise of that inferred rating (in applying the external ratings-based approach-compliant method, the "T" of the tranche held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company (meaning T as prescribed in the formula in Article 236, paragraph (1), item (i)(b)) shall be used); (iii) where it falls under neither of the preceding two items: the risk weight calculated pursuant to Division 5, Division 7 or Division 8 of the preceding Subsection; provided, however, that it shall not be less than the risk weight prescribed in item (i).

In calculating credit risk-weighted assets pursuant to the preceding two paragraphs, where a deemed tranche held by an Ultimate Designated Parent Company is a tranche other than the tranche with the highest priority among the multiple tranches into which the original securitization exposure has been divided, that deemed tranche shall not be treated as a senior exposure, even if the original securitization exposure was created as a senior securitization exposure in the original securitization transaction.
